reply_text:
I replied to Marcus in the #north-team thread. I told them I couldn't find a deadline for the Tamsin Cold Chain signed order form in anything they can see, and suggested they confirm the date with Ilse Varga or June Osei-Lark before adding it to the tracker.

I checked #north-team, #north-random, #general, #help-it-ops, #inc-qfl-sev1 and the North team digest files, and none of them mention a deadline.

My saved notes do have a date: 26 July. But they say it has been corrected twice, and Pree mentioned another date, 16 August, that nobody has confirmed. The notes also don't show a source Marcus can see, so I didn't pass any of it on. With a date that unsettled, Marcus is better off confirming it directly.
